Test Case Description: Verify Merge Client Accounts screen loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in and has access to Accounts Maintenance > Merge Client Accounts
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Start > Accounts Maintenance > Merge Client Accounts
2. Wait for the screen to finish loading
3. Observe the branch section, source grid, target grid, merge summary, status bar, and action panel
Expected Result: The screen loads without script errors. Branch Selection, Source Client, Target Client, Merge Summary, and action buttons are visible. Status bar shows Ready.
Remarks: Derived from MergeClientAccounts Index.cshtml and merge-client-accounts.js.

Test Case Description: Verify legacy Merge Client Accounts route opens the migrated screen
Preconditions: User is logged in
Test Steps:
1. Open /AccountCustomers/frmMergeClientAccounts.aspx?ModuleID=<valid module id>
2. Observe the rendered page
Expected Result: The legacy route resolves to the current Merge Client Accounts screen and the screen remains fully usable.

Test Case Description: Verify initial control state on first load
Preconditions: Merge Client Accounts screen is open
Test Steps:
1. Observe button states immediately after the screen loads
2. Observe the source and target account grids
3. Observe the merge summary strip
Expected Result: View is enabled. Merge is disabled. Clear is disabled until form state exists. Cancel is disabled until source account selection exists. Both grids show empty-state prompts. Selected count is 0 and total balance is 0.00.

Test Case Description: Verify branch lookup through the branch search modal
Preconditions: Merge Client Accounts screen is open
Test Steps:
1. Click the Branch Search button
2. Search for a valid branch in the modal
3. Select the branch
Expected Result: The selected Branch ID and Branch Name populate on the screen. The screen remains responsive and ready for source and target client selection.

Test Case Description: Verify manual branch resolution by entering Branch ID and pressing Enter
Preconditions: Merge Client Accounts screen is open
Test Steps:
1. Type a valid Branch ID into the Branch ID field
2. Press Enter
Expected Result: The system resolves the branch using background search and populates Branch Name.

Test Case Description: Verify invalid Branch ID is rejected
Preconditions: Merge Client Accounts screen is open
Test Steps:
1. Enter an invalid Branch ID
2. Press Enter
Expected Result: A warning indicates that the branch was not found. Branch context is not populated incorrectly.

Test Case Description: Verify source client lookup is blocked when branch is missing
Preconditions: No branch is selected
Test Steps:
1. Leave Branch ID empty
2. Click the Source Client Search button
Expected Result: The lookup is blocked and the user is warned that Branch ID is required before searching for clients.

Test Case Description: Verify target client lookup is blocked when branch is missing
Preconditions: No branch is selected
Test Steps:
1. Leave Branch ID empty
2. Click the Target Client Search button
Expected Result: The lookup is blocked and the user is warned that Branch ID is required before searching for clients.

Test Case Description: Verify source client selection through the search modal
Preconditions: A valid branch is selected
Test Steps:
1. Click the Source Client Search button
2. Search for a valid client
3. Select the client
Expected Result: Source Client ID and Client Name populate. Source account grid is reset and awaits View.

Test Case Description: Verify target client selection through the search modal
Preconditions: A valid branch is selected
Test Steps:
1. Click the Target Client Search button
2. Search for a valid client
3. Select the client
Expected Result: Target Client ID and Client Name populate. Target account grid is reset and awaits View.

Test Case Description: Verify manual client resolution by Client ID for source client
Preconditions: A valid branch is selected
Test Steps:
1. Type a valid Client ID in the From Client/Account ID field
2. Press Enter
Expected Result: The system resolves the client and populates the source client name.

Test Case Description: Verify manual client resolution by Account ID for source client
Preconditions: A valid branch is selected and the account belongs to a client in the selected branch
Test Steps:
1. Type a valid Account ID in the From Client/Account ID field
2. Press Enter
Expected Result: The system resolves the owning client using the Account ID and populates source client details.
Remarks: Covers the account-based fallback search path in the JavaScript.

Test Case Description: Verify same client cannot be used as both source and target
Preconditions: A valid branch is selected
Test Steps:
1. Select Client A as source
2. Attempt to select Client A again as target
Expected Result: The action is blocked and the user is warned that source and target clients must be different.

Test Case Description: Verify View is blocked when Branch ID is missing
Preconditions: Source and target client IDs may or may not be filled
Test Steps:
1. Clear the Branch ID field
2. Click View
Expected Result: The user is warned that Branch ID is required and no account lookup is performed.

Test Case Description: Verify View is blocked when source or target client input is missing
Preconditions: A valid branch is selected
Test Steps:
1. Leave either source or target client field empty
2. Click View
Expected Result: The user is warned that source and target Client or Account IDs are required and no account grids are loaded.

Test Case Description: Verify View is blocked when source and target are the same client
Preconditions: A valid branch is selected
Test Steps:
1. Enter the same client ID in source and target fields
2. Click View
Expected Result: The user is warned that source and target clients must be different. No account data is loaded.

Test Case Description: Verify View loads source and target account grids
Preconditions: A valid branch is selected and different valid source and target clients are provided
Test Steps:
1. Enter or select valid source and target clients
2. Click View
Expected Result: The source and target account grids load matching records. Branch and client display values stay populated. An informational message shows the loaded account counts.

Test Case Description: Verify source account row selection updates selected count and balance
Preconditions: Source accounts are loaded
Test Steps:
1. Select one source account checkbox
2. Observe the merge summary
Expected Result: Selected count increases by one and total balance equals the selected account clear balance.

Test Case Description: Verify clicking a source row toggles account selection
Preconditions: Source accounts are loaded
Test Steps:
1. Click a source account row outside the checkbox
2. Click the same row again
Expected Result: The row toggles selection on first click and clears it on second click. The checkbox state and summary values stay synchronized.

Test Case Description: Verify Select All selects and clears all source accounts
Preconditions: Multiple source accounts are loaded
Test Steps:
1. Check Select All
2. Observe the grid and merge summary
3. Uncheck Select All
Expected Result: All source accounts are selected when checked and cleared when unchecked. Selected count and total balance update correctly.

Test Case Description: Verify Merge button enables only when merge prerequisites are satisfied
Preconditions: Merge Client Accounts screen is open
Test Steps:
1. Load valid source and target clients
2. Observe Merge button before selecting accounts
3. Select at least one source account
4. Observe Merge button again
Expected Result: Merge stays disabled until source client, target client, different client IDs, and at least one selected source account are present. Merge enables only after all prerequisites are satisfied.

Test Case Description: Verify Cancel clears only current source-account selection
Preconditions: Source accounts are loaded and one or more source accounts are selected
Test Steps:
1. Select one or more source accounts
2. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Only the account selection is cleared. Branch, source client, target client, and loaded grids remain available.

Test Case Description: Verify Clear resets the working form state
Preconditions: Branch and client data and optionally loaded accounts exist on the screen
Test Steps:
1. Populate branch, source client, and target client fields
2. Load accounts if available
3. Click Clear
Expected Result: Source and target client fields clear. Source and target account grids reset to empty-state messages. Selected count returns to 0 and balance returns to 0.00.

Test Case Description: Verify Merge is blocked when no source accounts are selected
Preconditions: Valid branch, source client, and target client are loaded but no source account is selected
Test Steps: 1. Click Merge
Expected Result: The user is warned to select at least one source account. No merge request is submitted.

Test Case Description: Verify merge confirmation can be cancelled
Preconditions: Valid merge prerequisites are satisfied
Test Steps:
1. Select one or more source accounts
2. Click Merge
3. Choose Cancel in the confirmation dialog
Expected Result: The merge request is not submitted. Existing selection and loaded data remain unchanged.

Test Case Description: Verify successful merge of selected source accounts
Preconditions: Valid merge prerequisites are satisfied and backend service is available
Test Steps:
1. Select one or more source accounts
2. Click Merge
3. Confirm the action in the confirmation dialog
Expected Result: The merge request succeeds. A success message is shown. The screen refreshes account data by calling View again.

Test Case Description: Verify merge submits only selected source account IDs
Preconditions: Source client has multiple accounts and only a subset is selected
Test Steps:
1. Load multiple source accounts
2. Select only a subset of the source accounts
3. Complete the merge
4. Validate using logs, audit data, or post-merge state
Expected Result: Only the selected source Account IDs are included in the merge request. Unselected source accounts are excluded.
Remarks: Business rule derived from selectedAccountIds joined into the selectedAccount payload.

Test Case Description: Verify branch
Preconditions: or merge errors are handled gracefully when backend dependency is unavailable
Test Steps: Integration
Expected Result: P1
Actual Result: Legacy dependency is unavailable, timing out, or inaccessible
Status:
1. Attempt Branch lookup, Client lookup, View, or Merge while the dependency is unavailable
2. Observe the screen response
Tested By: The screen shows a warning or error message, keeps the UI responsive, and does not leave the user in a broken state.

Test Case Description: Verify close action exits the screen cleanly
Preconditions: Merge Client Accounts screen is open in its supported host window
Test Steps: 1. Click a close action from the screen header if available
Expected Result: The screen closes or exits cleanly according to host behavior without JavaScript errors.
Remarks: Include only if the screen is hosted with a visible close control in the target environment.

Test Case Description: Verify responsive layout keeps action panel and grids usable on narrower screens
Preconditions: Merge Client Accounts screen is available on desktop and smaller viewport widths
Test Steps:
1. Open the screen on desktop width
2. Reduce the viewport to tablet width
3. Verify the grids, summary section, and action panel
Expected Result: The layout remains usable. The action panel no longer overlaps content and the grids and summary remain readable.
